openings.claim: Prepare and verify order-specific parts sets before insertion; reduced shared-bin selection may reduce mixed-batch mistakes and delays.
openings.discriminator: Within matched layout/worker, selection/checking improves; insertion may remain unchanged.
openings.probe: Counterbalance samples; separately time selection, insertion, checking, packing, including preparation; inspect final parts/count/color.
openings.uncertainty: Required sets must be derivable from templates/slips; preparation, bench use, cost and deadline may erase savings. Complexity versus switching remains confounded.

openings.claim: Replace generic diagrams with ordered-layout guidance locating the short partition; clearer destinations may improve unaided arrangement.
openings.discriminator: Fewer placement errors and more ordered arrangements; persistent failures weaken guidance alone.
openings.probe: Compare diagrams among ten participants, balancing layout/exposure and verifying complete kits first.
openings.uncertainty: Prior learning limits generalization; preparation/printing cost and deadline feasibility unmeasured.

openings.claim: A reusable labeled packing map carries partitions then unfolds into destination guidance, permitting customer assembly. Independently verify map requirements/count/color against original slips before physical matching: silhouettes expose omissions, spatial correspondence guides placement, independent identity checking catches internally consistent wrong orders.
openings.discriminator: Detect planted omissions/substitutions and swapped maps/colors; reduce placement questions. Time falls only if preparation/loading/checks cost less than removed assembly.
openings.probe: Reuse up to 15 samples for three accepted counts, counterbalanced worker challenges; time preparation and both checks. Compare mapped/incumbent presentation with ten participants; verify capacity, removability, damage, costs and delivery.
openings.uncertainty: Accurate slips and practical two-worker/one-bench checks required. Similar parts, wrong maps, loose contents or rushed/shared mistakes defeat checks. Closure interlock parked: occupancy enforcement depends on shape discrimination/reversible retention and resisting empty-pocket defeat; cannot establish order identity.

lineage.reason: Inventory/destination coupling retained; speculative closure parked.

decision: Synthetic hypotheses only. Require 30x20 cm footprint, same stationery capacity, removable partitions/no permanent bonds, initial cost <=500, recurring addition <=0.40/order, accepted counts/colors and fixed delivery date. Ten-person comparisons are directional; assess 60-unit pilot: >=59 complete orders, median workshop time <=8 minutes, >=54 unaided arrangements. Gate adoption on measured feasibility.
